Indian Fencers Excel at Commonwealth Championship

Indian fencers achieved significant success at the U-23 Commonwealth Fencing Championship, securing multiple medals. On Day 2, the team won seven medals, including gold. By Day 3, India's medal tally reached 29, with the team adding three more golds. Fencer Tanishka Khatri made history by becoming the first Indian to win a Commonwealth Fencing Championship gold medal, contributing to the team's overall performance.
